testimonials.text: This institute changed my life! The courses are practical and the instructors are amazing.
The AI and Machine Learning track was incredibly rigorous. I highly recommend it.
I learned more here in 3 months than in 4 years of college.
Thodakkam completely transformed my career trajectory. The rigorous curriculum and incredible community support helped me land my dream role within 6 months of graduating.
The UX/UI design courses are top-notch. I went from having zero design experience to building a portfolio that got me multiple job offers. The instructors are phenomenal.
What sets Thodakkam apart is the focus on real-world projects. I built a payment gateway clone that became the main talking point in all my technical interviews.
I loved the practical approach to SQL and Python. The mock interviews and resume reviews were the cherry on top. An amazing platform for anyone looking to upskill quickly.

testimonials.text: The best investment I have made in my career. The mentors are accessible, and the curriculum is constantly updated with the latest industry trends and frameworks.

about.title: Empowering the Next Generation of Tech Leaders
about.description: At SK Institute, we are committed to providing top-tier education and practical training in modern technologies. Founded with the vision of bridging the gap between academic learning and industry demands, we offer comprehensive courses designed by experts. Our hands-on approach ensures that every student graduates with the skills, confidence, and portfolio needed to excel in today's competitive job market.
about.mission: To deliver accessible, high-quality technical education that empowers students to achieve their career goals and drive innovation in the tech industry.
about.vision: To become the most trusted and recognized institution for technical skill development, creating a global community of successful professionals.

founder.name: Srinivas K
founder.title: Founder & Lead Instructor
founder.bio: Srinivas is a passionate tech educator with over 15 years of industry experience working as a senior engineer at top software companies. He founded SK Institute with a single mission: to bridge the gap between traditional academic theory and real-world software engineering. Under his guidance, thousands of students have successfully transitioned into fulfilling careers in tech.
